我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
My friend Amy is very kind.
We talk about art a lot.
Amy often helps me with art.
The weekend breakfast is big and clean.
I go to the zoo every Friday.
column3: 我每星期五都去动物园。

我开心的一天(My Happy Day): Brothers sometimes argue over small things.
column3: 兄弟间有时会为小事争吵。
